title: Trust Under Fire
intent: Read two protected evacuation routes, their shelters and the broadcast relay without confusing them with military targets.
observed: The settled opening HUD is centered on a mostly empty dark paved yard with scattered props; no convoy is prominent in the usable center. Inspection shows a very regular container field, repeated small installations, a straight canal and bridge, and broad white concrete. The native receipt confirms both the source Sun and Match directional key are enabled.
camera: Frame the north convoy and its first safe route segment at deployment; provide a camera-only south-route/shelter view and an explicit return to the active convoy. Keep the 15-minute evacuation task visually tied to vehicles rather than an empty yard.
light: Compare a single intentional source key against the current two enabled 1.25-intensity keys, retaining only deliberate fill. Keep convoy silhouettes and shelter entrances readable; do not use the fogged high-altitude diagnostic overview to judge normal gameplay exposure.
ground: Make the protected north and south routes maintained service corridors with consistent shoulders and flush receiving crossovers. Break container-yard concrete into believable handling/stacking bays rather than a continuous identical tile grid. Give the canal a coherent engineered quay edge.
props: Group evacuation supplies and shade at the actual shelters, distinguish loading bays from empty container storage, and add a compact relay support cluster. Avoid arbitrary repeated isolated barrels across circulation space.
landscape: Group river-edge rocks and sediment where they meet banks rather than repeating evenly spaced stones down the channel; soften warehouse foundations and the sand-to-concrete edge.
